description: This file defines API routes for managing chess games, including creating, listing, retrieving, making moves, generating AI moves, and managing game snapshots. It uses FastAPI, SQLAlchemy, and custom chess logic modules to facilitate game operations and state management.

methods.name: MoveResponse _serialize_move(m: Move)
methods.description: Serializes a Move object into a MoveResponse schema for API responses.

methods.name: GameResponse _serialize_game(game: Game)
methods.description: Serializes a Game object into a GameResponse schema, including derived position flags.

methods.name: None _require_user_if_provided(db: Session, user_id: Optional[str])
methods.description: Checks if a given user_id exists in the database if provided, raising an HTTP 400 error if not.

methods.name: bool _side_to_move_is_ai(game: Game)
methods.description: Determines if the current side to move is controlled by AI based on game mode, ai_side, and move turn.

methods.name: GameResponse create_game(payload: CreateGameRequest, db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Creates a new chess game with optional players and AI settings, initializing the position to startpos.

methods.name: List[GameResponse] list_games( userId: Optional[str] = Query(None, description="Filter games by participant userId."), db: Session = Depends(get_db), )
methods.description: Lists all games, optionally filtered by a participant user ID, including move histories.

methods.name: GameResponse get_game(game_id: str, db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Fetches details of a specific game by its ID.

methods.name: GameResponse submit_move(game_id: str, payload: SubmitMoveRequest, db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Validates and applies a move submitted by a user, updating game state and move history.

methods.name: GameResponse ai_move(game_id: str, db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Generates and applies an AI move for the current AI-controlled side.

methods.name: SnapshotResponse save_game_snapshot(game_id: str, payload: SaveGameRequest, db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Saves the current game state as a snapshot with a specified name; performs upsert if snapshot name exists.

methods.name: GameResponse load_game_snapshot(game_id: str, payload: LoadGameRequest, db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Restores a game state from a named snapshot and deletes moves beyond the snapshot's move count.

methods.name: Response delete_game(game_id: str, db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Deletes a game and its related data from the database.
